note: Model configs use Anymake's own mechanism rather than inventing one — per-agent agent.<name>.model in the arena's opencode.json, plus ANYMAKE_MODEL_TIER1/2/3 in the cell env (AGENTS/arbiter.md → Model Tier Policy). Fill the <...> placeholders with the model ids you actually run; the harness reads the served model back from telemetry and records what was really used.
